feedback.message: Keep organism-level loop-of-loops typed, but preserve EVENT_BUS/fixed-depth baselines; add update-amplification and model-internal-vs-system-workspace discriminators to H1 Golden Trace planning.

Do not redesign BASE semantics. Re-run current V7 strict frontend and operator-identity gates with pinned Lark 1.3.1 and persist version-bound receipts before treating parser/canonical closure narratives as adjudicated. Independent proxy observed a strict IN/dotted_relation conflict and current expected receipt path was absent.

Add bounded semantic-update amplification, fixed-vs-adaptive recurrence, EVENT_BUS-vs-receiver-causal workspace, and peer-backflow baselines to matched replay. Preserve target-Ubuntu evidence boundary.
Measure affected dependency closure and worst-hub write amplification; incremental exactness without amplification bounds is insufficient.
Treat active topology as sparse derived state; benchmark hub invalidation and stale-edge suppression under epoch publication.
Preserve model-internal workspace-like representations as a separate measurement plane from system-level delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/re-entry.
Current alternative-preservation and higher-order reduction requirements remain compatible; no semantic revision forced.
No emergence promotion. Recurrence, workspace-like representations and incremental connectivity remain non-sufficient without intervention/lesion/rescue and nulls.

Cross-domain convergence strengthened around typed identity/epochs, adaptive resource allocation and incremental sparse maintenance, but all three require matched executable baselines rather than architectural promotion from analogy.
